system.description: This spell enables the recipient to see in the dark, to a 60' range, with the same sort of vision possessed by dwarves and elves. Infravision is the ability to see heat (and the lack of heat). Dwarves, elves, and casters of the infravision spell have infravision in addition to normal sight and can see 60' in the dark. Infravision does not work in normal and magical light. Fire and other heat sources can interfere with infravision, just as a bright flash of light can make normal vision go black for a short time. With infravision, warm things appear red, and cold things appear blue. For example, an approaching creature could be seen as a red shape, leaving faint reddish footprints.
